_default.why:
Water spots are caused by mineral deposits that damage your paint over time.

Fireball Water Spot Remover neutralizes these deposits safely, without scrubbing or damaging your coating.
howToUseSteps: Work on a cool surface, out of direct sunlight.
Spray onto a microfiber towel or applicator.
Wipe gently over the affected area.
Rinse or wipe with a damp towel, then dry.
